response.rationale: ECG shows transient ST elevations with only minimal coronary stenosis, classic for coronary vasospasm (variant angina); alcohol is a trigger. Arrhythmias and syncope are secondary effects.

rejected.why: No features of obstructive HCM; ECG and normal troponin do not support.
